scope: Supplementary frozen-weight dependence check, specified before completed paired outcomes; does not change the primary retrained comparison
transforms: set past XYZ to current XYZ with original validity/time
reflect past displacement around current XYZ, preserving the current row exactly
metrics: full100 actual action MSE and change
valid-scalar RMS change in predicted actions
reference: unperturbed actor-only predictions must match the saved fixed-checkpoint reference at spot checks; labels and window identity must match throughout
interpretation: Measures trained functional dependence and perturbation behavior. Cross-modal inconsistency can induce distribution shift, so this is not a substitute for the retrained Stationary/Observed comparison or closed-loop evidence. No primary winner selection uses these results.
